verdict.rationale: AFK is an AI-driven operations product that handles sensitive company data, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions model training, data-use policies, or any opt-out control. The documented security features (scoped OAuth, encrypted secrets, audit logs) are adjacent controls and do not address whether user data trains AI models.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
